description: Per-workload shape variants for the 4 hard-gate Qwen2.5-3B workloads. These variants parameterize the 17-op layer template to produce per-op cycle estimates. Schema: workload_id, batch_m, prompt_len, context_len, layer_count, hidden, intermediate, kv_heads, head_dim.

frozen_policies.no_auto_generation: All variant values are hand-described, not generated from Path A models.
frozen_policies.schema_locked: Fields must include workload_id, batch_m, prompt_len, context_len, layer_count, hidden, intermediate, kv_heads, head_dim.

variants.description: Single block-0 decode: batch=1, no KV history (context=0). 1 layer only.
36-layer decode with context=128, gen=1. All layers use decode interleaving mode.
36-layer prefill with prompt=16 tokens. Uses prefill model (batch_m=16). context=0 means first layer has no KV history.
36-layer prefill with prompt=128 tokens. Uses prefill model (batch_m=128).
